description: General UI polish across BOTH pages (the user's core ask): refine color palette, spacing/rhythm, typography, buttons and cards, quiz-taking feedback/animations, the result screen, empty/loading/error states, wording/microcopy, and mobile responsiveness; keep and improve dark-mode support. Provide polished CSS for the new admin management elements introduced in FEAT-002. Keep dependencies lean (hand-written CSS only, no heavy UI framework). Also update the README admin-workflow note to mention edit/delete. Depends on FEAT-002 (needs the final class names in AdminPage) and touches HomePage.tsx + styles.css.
steps: Rework frontend/src/styles.css: refine the CSS custom-property palette (light + prefers-color-scheme dark) for a more tasteful, cohesive look; improve spacing rhythm, typography scale, and card/button styling. Keep it tasteful, not garish, and keep ALL existing class names working (do not break selectors AdminPage/HomePage rely on). Preserve and improve dark-mode.

Polish quiz-taking feedback and the result screen in styles.css: refine .progress / .progress-bar / .progress-bar-fill, the .score-ring (keep the conic-gradient --percent mechanism used by HomePage inline style), .result-item correct/incorrect states, option hover/selected affordances. Add subtle, tasteful animations/transitions (e.g. fade/slide-in for cards or result items, progress fill transition), guarded by @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) to disable motion for users who opt out.

Improve empty/loading/error states styling (.status, .status.error, .empty-state) and general microcopy consistency. In HomePage.tsx you MAY refine user-facing wording/microcopy for richness (e.g. list header, empty state, loading, result encouragement) but keep the existing flow, view model (list/quiz/result), the answers=-1-for-unanswered logic, submit behavior, and the score/feedback semantics intact. Do not change api.ts calls or the data shapes.

Optionally add a small visual header/intro area or subtle result-screen encouragement message keyed off percent (e.g. different microcopy tiers) in HomePage.tsx WITHOUT changing scoring logic. Keep it lean and accessible (aria-labels already present on progress and score-ring must remain correct).

Provide polished CSS for the admin management elements added in FEAT-002 (e.g. admin-quiz-list, admin-quiz-item, admin-quiz-actions, admin-mode-heading, and any confirm modal classes if FEAT-002 used an in-app modal). Ensure the admin list, edit-mode heading, and per-quiz edit/delete actions look coherent with the rest of the admin form and are responsive.

Ensure mobile responsiveness: review the @media (max-width: 480px) block and extend as needed so the new admin list/actions and any modal are usable on small screens (buttons wrap/stretch sensibly, tap targets adequate).
Do NOT add any npm dependency. All polish is hand-written CSS plus minor JSX/microcopy tweaks. Do NOT change auth.ts, config.ts, api.ts data behavior, backend, or amplify.yml.

Update README.md '管理者ページと自作クイズの登録フロー' section (and/or the '今後の拡張候補' if appropriate) to note that the admin page now also lists existing quizzes and supports editing (full-replace) and deleting (with a confirmation dialog). Keep the deploy/URL guidance (Cognito callback = origin + /admin.html, multi-page build) accurate and unchanged in meaning. Do not touch amplify.yml.
acceptance_criteria: styles.css presents a refined, cohesive light + dark palette with improved spacing/typography/buttons/cards, and all existing class selectors used by HomePage.tsx and AdminPage.tsx still resolve.
Quiz-taking and result screens have tasteful polish including at least one subtle animation/transition that is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
The score-ring still works via the --percent conic-gradient mechanism driven by HomePage's inline style.
New admin management elements (list, edit-mode heading, per-quiz actions, any modal) are styled coherently and are responsive on small screens.
HomePage.tsx microcopy is refined without changing the list/quiz/result flow, scoring, or api calls.
No new npm dependency is added (package.json dependencies remain react + react-dom).
README.md documents the new edit/delete admin capability without altering the accurate deploy/URL guidance.
verification: Read styles.css and confirm no class used in HomePage.tsx / AdminPage.tsx was removed or renamed away, and that dark-mode + score-ring mechanisms are intact.
Read HomePage.tsx and confirm flow/scoring/api calls are unchanged (only microcopy/markup polish).
Confirm prefers-reduced-motion guard exists for any added motion.
Confirm frontend/package.json dependencies are still only react + react-dom (no framework added).
On the user's networked host: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build (tsc + vite must pass).
Confirm README.md updated and no changes to backend or amplify.yml.
findings: Reworked frontend/src/styles.css into a cohesive design system: expanded CSS custom-property palette (surfaces, brand, text, borders, state colors, radii, shadows, motion) for both light and improved prefers-color-scheme dark modes; refined spacing rhythm, typography scale (clamp() h1, tabular-nums for numeric readouts), buttons (inline-flex, focus-visible ring, active press), and cards. Polished quiz-taking (progress-bar gradient + width transition, option :has(input:checked) selected affordance) and result screen (score-ring conic-gradient --percent mechanism PRESERVED, correct/incorrect soft backgrounds, staggered result-item entrance). Added tasteful animations (card-in, item-in, ring-pop, status pulse) ALL disabled under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce). Styled the FEAT-002 admin elements (admin-quiz-list-card/header/list/item/title/count/actions, admin-mode-heading) coherently and made them stack on <=480px. Enumerated every className used in HomePage.tsx and AdminPage.tsx and confirmed all selectors still resolve (no removals/renames); braces balanced 117/117. AdminPage uses native window.confirm for delete, so no in-app modal CSS was needed. HomePage.tsx: microcopy only (richer empty-state text; added display-only encouragement() message keyed off percent as .result-message) - no change to list/quiz/result view model, answers=-1 logic, submit, scoring, aria-labels, or api.ts calls. README.md: documented the admin list + edit(full-replace, PUT) + delete(confirm dialog, DELETE) workflow and updated the overview bullet; deploy/URL/Cognito guidance and amplify.yml unchanged. package.json deps remain exactly react + react-dom; no lockfile generated. VERIFICATION LIMIT: sandbox is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY (npm 403), so npm install / tsc / vite build were NOT run here - verified correct-by-construction via reading. User must run 'cd frontend && npm install && npm run build' on a networked host.
